knight.reason: Core Knight: reliable Might/Guard defender without Brute burst.

rogue.reason: Starter Rogue with representative Dexterity, Agility, precision and fragility.

mage.reason: Starter Mage with a clear Focus/magic-pressure profile and low physical durability.

siren.reason: Controller Siren whose ailment tempo is not inflated by extreme direct damage.

inquisitor.reason: Central hybrid Inquisitor with offensive sustain and anti-magic identity.

bard.reason: Intentionally average hybrid Bard with no statistical spike.

brute.reason: Starter Brute expressing high HP and Might with low precision and mobility.

boss.reason: Duke reference uses the stable Knight combat profile.
